entries.title: Past events archive
entries.description: Finished events are no longer removed from the calendar. Once an event has ended (Oslo time) it moves automatically to a new Past events section at the bottom of the calendar, newest first. The office screen shows only upcoming events.

entries.title: Denmark added
entries.description: Nordic Crypto now covers Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland and Iceland. Denmark has a country filter on the news, calendar, who's who and academia pages, and we now follow Danish newspapers, broadcasters, tech media, Danmarks Nationalbank, Kaupr's Denmark page and a news search on Danish sites. Danish stories, events and who's who entries appear once our editor has reviewed them.

entries.title: Coverage narrowed to four countries
entries.description: Nordic Crypto now covers Norway, Sweden, Finland and Iceland. The Faroe Islands have been removed from the news sources, country filters, calendar, who's who, Regulation by country section, academia page and office screen.

entries.title: Academia page
entries.description: New Academia page: blockchain and crypto courses and programmes, student associations, publications and research groups at universities in Norway, Sweden, Finland, Iceland and the Faroe Islands. Every row shows its source, the date we checked it and its status; only editor-approved rows are shown.

entries.title: Nordic Crypto launches
entries.description: First version of the site in English: news from Norway, Sweden, Finland, Iceland and the Faroe Islands with our own short summaries; an events calendar with a month grid, a mobile list and a country filter; a who's who of the industry and its regulators split into private and public sector, with a country filter; a Regulation by country section; the list of sources we follow; an About page with corrections and removal; and a full-screen office screen mode for portrait and landscape displays.
